assessments.rationale: It is restricted to PR/diff change-set reviews and explicitly routes pure design critique out; it cannot evaluate a scientific proposal deck’s claims, study design, and panel readiness.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Integrated readiness review of the proposal’s claims, study plan, audience fit, and slide evidence.
assessments.rationale: It builds study schedules and flashcards, not an evidence, design, and audience review of a proposal deck.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Integrated assessment of scientific claim support, study-plan credibility, and hospital-panel fit.
assessments.rationale: It supplies dual visual/content QA and narrative checks for slides, but its workflow is a generation/polish system and lacks an integrated assessment of scientific claim support, study credibility, and hospital-panel fit.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Integrated review of visual evidence, study credibility, and hospital-panel readiness for a slide deck.
assessments.rationale: It calibrates scientific prose but explicitly prefers another skill for slides or posters and does not integrate visual evidence, study credibility, and hospital audience readiness.

assessments.rationale: It directly covers holistic, prioritized critique of talks and study proposals across claims, evidence, design, story, audience fit, blocking issues, assumptions, and a revision path.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A coherent scientific proposal-readiness review rather than US engineering-firm discovery.
assessments.rationale: It is solely a ServiceGraph workflow for finding and vetting US real-world engineering firms, with no proposal-review capability.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Review of an existing scientific proposal deck’s claims, study plan, audience fit, and visual evidence.
assessments.rationale: It conducts pre-design UI-convention research and explicitly excludes judging a finished artifact; it does not assess scientific proposal readiness.
